data.heading: How a Python loop works
data.narration: Welcome! Today we will learn how a Python loop works. A loop lets your program repeat a task again and again, without writing the same code many times.

cues.text: Today we will learn how a Python loop works.
A loop lets your program repeat a task again and again, without writing the same code many times.

data.heading: The for loop
data.narration: Here is a simple for loop. The range(3) call gives us the numbers 0, 1 and 2. For each number, the variable i takes that value, and print shows it on the screen.

cues.text: Here is a simple for loop.
The range(3) call gives us the numbers 0, 1 and 2.
For each number, the variable i takes that value, and print shows it on the screen.

data.heading: How the loop runs
data.narration: Watch how the loop runs. First, i is 0, and print shows 0. Then i becomes 1, then 2, and after that the loop stops.

cues.text: First, i is 0, and print shows 0.
Then i becomes 1, then 2, and after that the loop stops.

data.heading: Recap
data.subheading: A loop repeats code for every value
data.narration: To recap, a loop repeats the same code for every value. Use range to say how many times, and print to see each result. Now try changing the number inside range yourself!
